import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path('/home/liuxuedeng/Django-Agent')
directory = root / 'docs/refactor-evidence/20261011-root-pub-current-profile'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

command = json.loads((directory / 'command.json').read_text())
current_sources = {relative: sha(root / relative) for relative in command['source_before']}
assert current_sources == command['source_before'] == command['source_after'], 'Profile source binding has changed'
raw_unchanged = []
for item in command['files']:
    path = root / item['path']
    assert sha(path) == item['sha256'], 'Original profile evidence changed: ' + str(path)
    raw_unchanged.append({'path': item['path'], 'sha256': item['sha256']})

report_path = directory / 'profile-analysis.json'
report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
report['source_sha256_verified_against_original_receipt'] = current_sources
report['profile_roles'] = {
    'CPU.20261011.185350.2969238.0.001.cpuprofile': 'actual core/document-workflow test main thread; business stacks observed',
    'CPU.20261011.185350.2969238.1.002.cpuprofile': 'ESM/tsx loader helper thread inferred from internal esm/worker/hooks and absence of business stacks; not chunk algorithm worker',
    'filename_limit': 'same PID, different thread suffixes; filenames alone cannot identify a separate parent/test child process',
}
tap = (directory / 'large-local.tap').read_text()
stage_receipt = next(json.loads(line[2:]) for line in tap.splitlines() if line.startswith('# {'))
report['business_stage_receipt'] = stage_receipt
report['command_elapsed_ms_not_business_time'] = command['command_elapsed_ms']
report['manual_generated_frame_to_source_mapping'] = {
    'pipeline.ts@1:8960': 'pipeline.ts:184, publication outer work; parent of body and outer synchronous transaction',
    'pipeline.ts@1:9207': 'pipeline.ts:191, unique pub body containing both CoreDatabase.insertMany and SearchIndex.indexKeywords',
    'search-index.ts@12:816': 'search-index.ts:76, indexKeywords #write callback; direct run calls only FTS DELETE/INSERT at lines97/98',
    'basis': 'same-source SHA plus unique callback call graph, not an automatically recovered sourcemap',
}
report['sql_plan_evidence'] = {'file': 'profile-analysis-sql-plan.json', 'sha256': sha(directory / 'profile-analysis-sql-plan.json'),
    'database': ':memory:', 'production_database_opened': False, 'original_schema_and_local_native_binding': True,
    'semantic_fixture_only': True, 'performance_measurement': False}
report['limits'] = [
    'No monotonic stage markers: weighted publication subtrees are not exact wall-time slices.',
    'Inclusive values overlap and cannot all be summed.',
    'Database.run wraps native Statement.run; V8 does not separately report SQLite tokenizer/merge/I/O work.',
    'Two direct FTS statements share one callback frame and generated line; this profile cannot split DELETE and INSERT timings.',
    'Transaction wrapper self includes before/after native calls; cannot assert all is COMMIT.',
    'No P95, packaged/native GUI responsiveness, HTTP/IPC latency pass or small SQL speedup claimed.',
]
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

scripts = [pathlib.Path('/tmp/marlin-current-publication-profile-analysis-20261011.py'),
    pathlib.Path('/tmp/marlin-current-publication-sql-plan-20261011.mjs'), pathlib.Path(__file__)]
archives = [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(path), 'content': path.read_text()} for path in scripts]
for path in scripts:
    path.unlink()
for item in archives:
    item['removed_after_archive'] = not pathlib.Path(item['path']).exists()

analysis_paths = sorted(path for path in directory.glob('profile-analysis*') if path.is_file())
for path in analysis_paths:
    assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in path.read_text().splitlines()), 'Trailing whitespace: ' + str(path)
    if path.suffix == '.md':
        for link in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
            if link == 'profile-analysis-cleanup.json':
                continue
            assert path.parent.joinpath(link).exists(), 'Broken analysis link: ' + link
diff = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check', '--', *(str(path.relative_to(root)) for path in analysis_paths)],
    cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
assert diff.returncode == 0, diff.stdout + diff.stderr
cleanup = {'recorded_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'owned_scope': 'only newly created profile-analysis* evidence in this directory; original profiles/TAP/receipt/source readonly',
    'original_raw_inputs_unchanged': raw_unchanged,
    'original_source_sha256_unchanged': current_sources,
    'analysis_files_sha256': {path.name: sha(path) for path in analysis_paths},
    'temporary_script_archives': archives,
    'all_owned_temporary_scripts_removed': all(item['removed_after_archive'] for item in archives),
    'analysis_execution': {
        'cpu_profile_analysis_command': ['python3', '/tmp/marlin-current-publication-profile-analysis-20261011.py'],
        'cpu_profile_analysis_exit': 0,
        'initial_sql_fixture_exit': 1, 'initial_sql_fixture_error': 'ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED default prebuild GLIBC_2.33; corrected fixture to actual core explicit local binding',
        'corrected_sql_fixture_command': ['node', '/tmp/marlin-current-publication-sql-plan-20261011.mjs'],
        'corrected_sql_fixture_exit': 0,
        'initial_error_log_is_an_excerpt_with_context': True,
    },
    'verification': {'relative_links_exist': True, 'owned_trailing_whitespace': False, 'git_diff_check_exit': diff.returncode},
    'boundary': {'product_source_modified': False, 'live_database_access': False, 'isolated_in_memory_sqlite_only': True,
        'second_production_writer': False, 'new_cpu_profile_run': False, 'new_large_ingestion': False,
        'real_model_or_api_calls': 0, 'gui_access': False, 'credentials_access': False, 'committed': False}}
output = directory / 'profile-analysis-cleanup.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(cleanup, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'cleanup': str(output), 'cleanup_sha256': sha(output), 'analysis_files_sha256': cleanup['analysis_files_sha256'],
    'temporary_scripts_removed': cleanup['all_owned_temporary_scripts_removed']}, ensure_ascii=False))
